Kebaby - Well worth the walk!
Jul 2024 • Couples
My wife and I were in Ho Chi Minh and fancied a kebab, I did some searching and found Kebaby! It was a few KM walk for us, but worth it! Food was great, friendly service and good price in a cool part of the City. We walked in the evening there and was great seeing Landmark 81 stand out amongst all the colourfully lit buildings! For a meal for 2 and drinks we paid about £12-15 total. Well worth it and I recommend you to go!
